name: Parity
summary: Parity is a deterministic-first Oracle to PostgreSQL SQL & PL/SQL migration and transpilation engine with a 5-layer mathematical verification stack and zero raw data leakage.
recruiterExplanation: Parity demonstrates Cimil's deep mastery of compilers, language engineering, and formal verification. Rather than relying on non-deterministic LLMs that produce silent semantic errors in enterprise database migrations (such as Oracle null-string equivalence or outer join semantics), Cimil built an AST-driven rewrite engine verified by 5 mathematical layers—syntax parsing, type schema parity, relational algebra, differential symbolic execution, and automated GitHub PR creation. The system achieves a 94% verified pass rate on a 500-object enterprise benchmark.
technicalExplanation: The core transpiler operates on Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) using sqlglot and custom dialect rules to map Oracle SQL and PL/SQL semantics to ANSI/PostgreSQL equivalents. Transpiled code is verified across 5 distinct layers: Layer 1 checks syntactic validity and grammar via dual-engine AST parsing. Layer 2 verifies type system and schema parity against target catalog definitions. Layer 3 proves relational algebra equivalence. Layer 4 performs differential symbolic execution with zero raw data leakage to guarantee identical runtime behavior on edge-case semantics (e.g. ORA_DIFF_001 null handling, string concatenation, outer joins, and ROWNUM evaluation order). Layer 5 integrates with GitHub Actions to emit automated migration PRs.
architectureExplanation: Deterministic-first modular compiler architecture. Separation of the syntax transformation stage from the mathematical verification pipeline. The verification pipeline acts as an immutable gatekeeper: candidate queries are proposed by either rewrite rules or constrained LLMs, but are only accepted if all 5 verification layers mathematically certify semantic equivalence.
features: Deterministic AST Transpilation for Oracle to PostgreSQL
94% Verified Pass Rate across 500 Enterprise Objects
Automated GitHub Pull Request Generation with Migration Diffs
aiModels: Constrained LLM Transpilation Fallback with Mathematical Verification Gate

faqs.q: Why can't generic LLMs reliably migrate Oracle SQL to PostgreSQL?
faqs.a: Generic LLMs only ensure syntactic validity; they frequently fail silently on runtime semantics such as Oracle treating empty strings as NULL, string concatenation with NULL, legacy (+) outer joins, and ROWNUM execution order. Parity uses a 5-layer verification stack that mathematically checks relational algebra and differential symbolic execution before approving any migration.

faqs.q: What benchmark was used to validate Parity?
faqs.a: Parity was evaluated against an enterprise benchmark of 500 diverse Oracle SQL and PL/SQL objects spanning base queries, legacy outer joins, complex analytic functions, subqueries, and PL/SQL blocks, achieving an overall verified pass rate of 94%.
